title: GlucoFM: A Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2605.30865v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) provides a dense view of daily metabolic physiology, yet existing generic time-series and CGM-specific foundation models often encode glucose traces as entangled single-stream sequences, leaving their multiscale temporal structure only implicitly modeled. We present GlucoFM, a lightweight CGM foundation model that aligns irregular recordings to a 24-hour chronological grid, preserves observation masks, and decomposes glucose dynamics into slow-varying glycemic trend and short-term deviation streams. GlucoFM is pretrained on 109,066 hours of unlabeled CGM recordings from 477 subjects with masked contextual latent prediction over fused daily representations and temporal dynamics prediction over the two streams. translated_title: GlucoFM：一种用于连续血糖监测的双流基础模型
translated_abstract: 连续血糖监测（CGM）提供了日常代谢生理的密集视图，然而现有的通用时间序列和CGM专用基础模型通常将血糖轨迹编码为纠缠的单流序列，仅隐式建模其多尺度时间结构。我们提出GlucoFM，一种轻量级CGM基础模型，它将不规则记录对齐到24小时时间网格，保留观测掩码，并将血糖动态分解为慢变血糖趋势和短期偏差流。GlucoFM在来自477名受试者的109,066小时未标记CGM记录上进行预训练，通过融合每日表示的掩码上下文潜在预测和两流的时态动态预测。冻结的融合前探针确认了不同的时间重点：状态令牌优先保留每小时血糖水平，而事件令牌更好地保留短期变化。在四个不同的...
tldr: GlucoFM通过双流分解和轻量级设计，在CGM基础模型中显式建模多尺度时间结构，提升了血糖动态预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: GlucoFM explicitly models multiscale temporal structure in CGM foundation models via dual-stream decomposition and lightweight design, improving glucose dynamics prediction accuracy.
